name: Schlegeisspeicher
kurzbeschreibung: Schlegeisspeicher in the upper Zillertal features turquoise waters, a monumental 131 m dam wall, and the famous Olpererhaus suspension bridge.
beschreibung:
Overview

The magnificent Schlegeisspeicher reservoir sits at an elevation of 1,782 meters in the upper Zillertal and is one of the most breathtaking high-alpine reservoirs in the Austrian Alps. Framed by glaciated three-thousand-meter giants such as the Hochfeiler and the Großer Möserler, the fjord-like, turquoise-blue lake provides a breathtaking backdrop. At the heart of the complex stands the monumental, 131-meter-high and 725-meter-long double-curved concrete arch dam, constructed between 1965 and 1973 as a pinnacle of alpine civil engineering. It impounds up to 126.5 million cubic meters of glacial meltwater to generate clean hydroelectric peak power for Verbund AG. Today, the entire lakeside area serves as a premier destination for nature lovers, families, hikers, and seasoned alpinists from across the world.

Route & Requirements

The dam crest and the immediate lakeside esplanade are completely level and barrier-free from the main car park, making the reservoir ideal for families with pushchairs and seniors. A well-maintained walking trail meanders along the picturesque eastern shoreline to the traditional Zamsereck-Alm hut (approx. 45 minutes walking, easy) and into the head of the valley. For mountain hikers, the reservoir is the trailhead for legendary alpine routes, such as the trek up to the Olpererhaus (approx. 1.5 hours, 600 vertical meters, moderate) with its world-famous suspension bridge, or to the historic Berliner Hütte. Sturdy boots with grippy profile soles and warm, weatherproof layers are essential in this high-altitude alpine environment. Climbers can tackle the Schlegeis131 via ferrata bolted directly onto the dam face or glide across the dizzying Flying Fox.

Visit & Arrival

Schlegeisspeicher is open daily during the snow-free summer months from mid-May to late October. Access from Mayrhofen follows the scenic Schlegeis Alpine Road (approx. 13 km with single-lane tunnels and traffic light control; car toll approx. €15.50). Public transport users take the Zillertalbahn train to Mayrhofen and transfer to bus line 4102 running directly to the dam wall. Verbund offers fascinating guided tours through the interior inspection tunnels of the massive dam structure.

Tips

Hike from the reservoir up to the Olpererhaus to capture the world-famous photograph on the suspension bridge overlooking the turquoise reservoir far below. Afterwards, stop at the Almgasthaus Schlegeis to enjoy freshly baked Tyrolean Zillertaler Krapfen pastries on the sunny panoramic terrace.
preis: Reservoir area freely accessible; Schlegeis Alpine Road toll applies (cars approx. €15.50)
oeffnungszeiten: Open daily from mid-May to late October (closed in winter)
